meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次执行 Bash 命令都会自动经过 rtk 代理，压缩命令输出，在 git、cargo、pytest 等常用开发命令上节省 60–90% token。技能会自动安装 rtk、挂载到容器并注册钩子。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要执行 Bash 命令时触发，例如运行 git status、cargo build、pytest 等。所有 Bash 调用都会被 rtk 拦截处理。

say.text: 帮我运行 git status 查看当前仓库状态。
say.note: 会通过 rtk 代理执行，输出被压缩。

say.text: 执行 cargo build 编译这个项目。

say.note: 命令经 rtk 代理，结果精简。

howto.what_en: After installation, every Bash command Claude runs goes through the rtk proxy, compressing output and saving 60–90% tokens on common dev commands like git, cargo, pytest. The skill installs rtk, mounts it into containers, and registers a PreToolUse hook.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude runs a Bash command (e.g. git, cargo, pytest). All Bash calls are intercepted by rtk via the PreToolUse hook.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current repo state.
say_en.note: Executed via rtk proxy, output compressed.

say_en.text: Run cargo build to compile this project.
say_en.note: Also goes through rtk, saving tokens.

say_en.text: Run pytest to execute the tests.
say_en.note: Command proxied by rtk, concise results.
